sessions.name: 2-Week Taste of Pembroke (first-time campers entering grades 2-5)

sources.note: 'girls ages 7-16'; summer address 306 Oldham Street, Pembroke.

Session prices are returning-camper rates; first-time campers pay $200-$500 less (e.g. $13,990 full season, $8,625 first session, $8,325 second session). Rising grades 8-10 add an overnight trip fee. 2027 enrollment open.

camps.name: Camp Wing Overnight
camps.description_short: Donor-funded 12-day overnight sessions on a 170-acre Duxbury campus with pools, a boating pond, fields and a ropes course, for kids who have completed grades 2-8. Priority goes to Boston and Brockton children with financial need and returning families.
camps.refund_policy_summary: All payments are nonrefundable, including for cancellations, non-attendance, late arrivals or early departures.

sources.note: Only cost is a $150 enrollment fee per camper per session; transportation and food covered. Serves campers who completed grades 2-8 (grade fields left empty since 'completed' grades are not entering grades). Page lists dates without a year; 2026 confirmed by weekdays (Tue-Sat) and the day camp page's 'Summer 2026'. Address is the Camp Office. Page states ACA accreditation.

camps.name: Camp Wonderland
camps.description_short: Salvation Army overnight camp in Sharon where campers stay five nights in cabins and swim, boat, do low ropes, archery, crafts and Christian education. Separate weeks serve ages 6-12, Salvation Army program kids, and teens 13-16.

sessions.name: Session 2 - Program Camp (ages 6-14, Salvation Army program participants)
Session 3 - Program Camp (ages 6-14, Salvation Army program participants)

sources.note: Page footer: 'Camp Wonderland is an ACA accredited camp.'
FAQ prints the ZIP as '20267', an evident typo for Sharon's 02067. Cost is set by each family's local Salvation Army sender unit (no price published). Sessions are 5 nights.

camps.name: Behn Basketball Camp at Babson College (Coed Day)
camps.description_short: Four-day basketball day camp in Babson College's gyms focused on fundamentals, shooting, team play and games, with players grouped by age and gender.

sources.note: Lunch provided by Babson Dining and included in tuition. Registration through US Sports Camps.
Babson College address 231 Forest Street, Babson Park, MA 02457 (camp page places it in Wellesley).

camps.name: Brookline Arts Center Summer Art Programs
camps.description_short: Week-long, full-day studio art programs at the Brookline Arts Center for ages 5-17, grouped by age, covering ceramics, drawing and painting, comics, mixed media, and jewelry and metalsmithing for teens.

sources.note: Page currently lists 2026 Weeks 5-10 only. Session price is the $730 class fee for most ages 5-12 classes; ceramics $810, teen jewelry (9am-2pm) $521; materials fee $45-$55 extra.

camps.name: Summer Junior Program
camps.description_short: Youth sail small boats on the Charles River Basin, starting with a two-week beginner class and moving up through intermediate, racing, windsurfing and STEM classes, with open sailing and paddling outside class time. One summer membership covers all classes and boat use.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Members must be able to swim 50 yards and may be asked for written swim proof; CBI does not run its own swim test.

sessions.name: Summer Junior Program (full season, weekdays 8:30am-3pm, closed July 4)

sources.note: Season June 15-Aug 21, 2026, weekdays 8:30-3:00. Welcome page shows sliding scale $1-$450; FAQ and Getting Started pages say $1-$445 (FAQ figure used).
Eligible: turn 10 before Aug 31 and not 18 before first day. No busing; fee is need-based sliding scale.

camps.name: Steps To Lead Summer Youth Sailing (Charlestown)
camps.description_short: Kids learn to sail keelboats and later dinghies on Boston Harbor from Pier 4 in the Charlestown Navy Yard, moving up a five-step curriculum over several summers. Spots are assigned by a February lottery and fees are need-based.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Cancellations between March 15 and May 31 get a full refund minus a 3% processing fee; no refunds from June 1 to the start of the program.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Students must show proof they can swim 75 yards and tread water for 90 seconds; Step 3 and above get an on-site swim check.

sessions.name: Step 1 Session 3: Sailing 101 (4-day, no program Aug 10)
Step 2 Session 2: Beginner Sailing (no program July 20)
Step 3 Session 2: Intermediate Sailing (no program July 20)
Step 4 Session 2: Beginner Dinghy Sailing (no program July 20)
Step 5 Session 2: Advanced Sailing (no program July 20)

sources.note: 'Programs for kids 8-18'; lottery Feb 1-15, 2026.
Full (non-scholarship) class fees; full and ~50% partial scholarships by income. Extended Day $50/week. Jamaica Pond and invitation-only Swim Sail Science sessions excluded.
Program hours 8:45am-3:15pm; Step 1 age 8+, Step 2 9+, Step 3 11+, Step 4 12+, Step 5 13+.
Families pack a bagged lunch.
Site lists Pier 4, Charlestown Navy Yard, Charlestown, MA 02129; Charlestown is a Boston neighborhood, so city set to Boston.

camps.name: CRS Summer - Charles River Creative Arts Program
camps.description_short: Multi-arts day program on the Charles River School campus in Dover where campers build a schedule of visual and performing arts classes, plus nature, STEM and sports, in two-week sessions.

sources.note: Ages 4-15 across programs; lunch included daily in dining hall.
Sessions are CRCAP (rising grades 2-7) 2026 prices; Creative Starts (ages 4-7) is $1,537-$1,707 per session. Aftercare until 5:30pm for an extra fee. Address from page footer. 2027 not yet posted.

camps.name: Dexter Southfield SciTech Camp
camps.description_short: Week-long STEM camp for ages 8-12 at Dexter Southfield in Brookline where campers work in teams on a themed build or challenge each week (kites, arcade games, escape rooms, forensics) and compete on Fridays.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Non-refundable $250 deposit per week or session; partial refunds less the deposit until June 1.

sources.note: 2026 dates, themes and fees; Week 1 is 4 days; DroneTogether joins weeks 2-7.
Before Camp $20/day, After Camp $40/day.
Bus $110/week.

camps.name: Summer Maritime Explorers Program
camps.description_short: Teens row the museum's open-water boats out of its Windmill Point Boathouse, with a different weekly focus such as powerboat handling under a licensed captain, rowing to Peddocks Island, marine ecology and chart navigation.

sources.note: Meets Tue-Thu 9:00-12:30 at the boathouse; loaner PFDs and boats provided. Street address of the Windmill Point Boathouse is not published; ZIP is the museum's Hull mailing ZIP.
$130 non-members, $120 members per week (session prices use the non-member rate).

camps.name: Learn To Sail (LTS) Program
camps.description_short: One-week morning learn-to-sail sessions in Hull for beginners age 7 and up, sailing small plastic Zim Prams in groups of about 12-16 with certified instructors. Open to non-members; boats are provided.

sources.note: Mon-Fri 9am-noon, $312 per 1-week session. Families of sailors over 12 are asked to contact the program director about boat choice.

camps.name: Piers Park Sailing Center Summer Youth Programs
camps.description_short: Full-day summer programs on the East Boston waterfront: Harbor Explorers (ages 6-9) mixes sailing, kayaking, fishing off the dock and marine science, and Science of Sailing (ages 10-13) ties sailing to hands-on STEM lessons.
camps.special_needs_notes: Students with physical disabilities get free or discounted tuition through the Peabody Foundation; an adaptive worksheet lets guardians request accommodations.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: All participants, including Harbor Explorers, must pass a swim assessment.

sources.note: Address listed as East Boston, MA 02128; East Boston is a Boston neighborhood, so city set to Boston.
Mon-Fri 9am-4pm. Sliding scale up to $450/week (full price used for 1-week Harbor Explorers sessions; 2-week Science of Sailing price not stated). Extended day 8:30-5:30 for $50/week.

camps.name: Tufts Children's Theater
camps.operator_name: Tufts University Department of Theatre, Dance, and Performance Studies
camps.description_short: Summer theater programs at Tufts University in Medford: Creative Arts (ages 7-12) rotates daily through drama, dance, art and music, and Magic Circle Theater (ages 11-16) rehearses and stages productions on performance or technical tracks.

sources.note: Tentative 2027 dates; registration opens around Dec 1. Address is the department's (Aidekman Arts Center). 2027 tuition not yet posted.
Creative Arts ages 7-12, 9am-4pm; lunch in university dining hall included in tuition.
Magic Circle Theater ages 11-16.
